title: Agreement
description: A standing contract between two parties that the matching must apply rather than ignore: which garages an insurer will pay for, which company may recover on which road section and within what response time, which network a fleet company prefers. The rules array is machine-readable on purpose. This is precisely the knowledge that today sits only with the planners, and prose in a contract document would leave it there. Held in the eVault of the party that publishes the agreement. A membershipInvitation is the exception: the company admin and the invited person each hold a copy, and the person's acceptance is what lets the company write the Membership.

agreementId.description: Identifier of the agreement. Both parties' copies of a two-sided agreement carry the same value.

canonicalOwnerEName.description: eName of the publishing party eVault

agreementType.description: What kind of agreement this is. It decides how the matching reads the scope and the rules.

partyENames.description: eNames of every party bound by the agreement, the publishing party included

title.description: Short name of the agreement for people, such as the contract name

scope.description: What the agreement covers. An empty scope means it applies everywhere the parties operate.

roadSectionIds.description: roadSectionId values of the RoadSections covered, for a roadAuthorityRecovery agreement

garageENames.description: eNames of the garages covered, for a garage network

providerENames.description: eNames of the service providers covered

regions.description: Names of the regions covered, as the parties name them

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes of the countries covered

vehicleClasses.description: Vehicle classes covered, such as passenger car, van or truck

rules.description: Applied automatically by the matching. Each rule is one machine-readable constraint, not a clause of prose.

ruleType.description: The kind of constraint. It decides how value is read: minutes, kilograms, a rate, an eName or a flag.

appliesToEName.description: Narrows the rule to one party, where the agreement covers several

note.description: Explanation of the rule for people

validFrom.description: When the agreement starts to apply

validUntil.description: When the agreement stops applying. Null or absent means open-ended.

status.description: A partnership or invitation starts as proposed and becomes active only when the other party accepts

proposedByOrgEName.description: The party that asked. Both parties hold a copy with the same agreementId. Absent on agreements made by one party alone.

offeredRole.description: Only on a membershipInvitation: the role the invited person gets in the company if they accept. partyENames is the company first, then the person.

decidedByEName.description: Who answered: an admin of the other party for a partnership, the invited person for a membershipInvitation

decidedAt.description: When the other party accepted or declined

documentUri.description: w3ds://file URI of the signed contract the rules were derived from

createdAt.description: When the record was first written

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed

revision.description: Starts at 1 and goes up by one on every change to the record
